name: GOTLAND BASIN
description: Two merchant ships are making a southbound passage east of Gotland, protected by a Danish frigate and a German corvette. Opposing Baltic Fleet combatants are in the basin. Escort the merchants to their separate rendezvous and protect fishing traffic. Identification and convoy progress matter more than destroying every contact. Real geography and real platform families; the conflict, the deployment and the tactical situation are fiction.

map.anchor_note: World coordinates are nautical miles about this point; one minute of latitude is one mile and longitude is scaled by the cosine of the anchor latitude.
map.chart_note: Natural Earth 1:10m · local projection · no depth data

objectives.text: Escort both merchant ships to their southern rendezvous. Loss of either merchant or the fishing vessel fails the mission.

forces: NATO: 1 frigate, 1 corvette (drone det)  ·  Russia: 1 corvette, 1 missile ship  ·  Neutral: dense merchant traffic
